page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6r.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated arm64 vCPUs utilizing the Ampere Altra processor architecture running at a baseline clock speed of 2.8 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-threaded capabilities alongside moderate single-core execution. The instance achieves a strong multi-core stress-ng CPU score of 114,420.62 and a strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 418.6 GB/sec, contrasting with a weaker single-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 8.38 GB/sec. Memory subsystem performance is highlighted by a strong cached small-block read bandwidth of 4,547.79 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds remain in the average tier at 175.98 GB/sec and 77.22 GB/sec respectively. Database operations are highly efficient, as demonstrated by a strong Redis SET throughput of 84.36 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64-based Ampere Altra architecture delivers high physical core density and strong multi-threaded performance relative to its resource profile, making it a viable alternative to x86-64 platforms for highly parallelizable workloads. The lack of bundled local storage and GPU hardware positions this instance for workloads that do not require local disk caching or hardware acceleration. This server is suited for multi-threaded applications, Redis-based caching layers, static web serving, and moderate-scale LLM inference tasks.
